result.brief: 提出面向开放世界家庭环境的机器人智能体基准，含真实到仿真构建的50个场景与多层级任务评测，统一比较VLA/WAM与智能体架构。
result.reason: Benchmark for robot agents in simulated open-world households, comparing VLA/WAM models and agent architectures; contributes evaluation infrastructure for embodied world-model applications rather than representation learning.
